build_fbt_geometry: build a StandardGeometry from a single-slice FBT LY file and L data dictionary
build_fbt_geometry_provider: build a StandardGeometryProvider from a bundled FBT LY file with multiple time slices
validate_fbt_data: validate FBT LY and L data dictionaries for required keys and correct array shapes
extract_ly_slice: extract a single LY slice from a bundled LY file at a given index
configure_fbt_geometry: configure an FBT geometry with Pydantic model including LY object, L object, and divertor domain
